name: site-astro
description: Humanity Superintelligence Readiness Index - Interactive Website

scripts.build: node scripts/validate_wishes.mjs && node scripts/validate_heritage.mjs && astro build
scripts.build:preview: node -e "process.env.PUBLIC_SHOW_DRAFTS='true'; require('child_process').execSync('node scripts/validate_wishes.mjs && node scripts/validate_heritage.mjs && astro build', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
scripts.build:dev: node -e "process.env.PUBLIC_SHOW_DRAFTS='true'; process.env.PUBLIC_SHOW_DEV_BREAKTHROUGHS='true'; require('child_process').execSync('node scripts/validate_wishes.mjs && node scripts/validate_heritage.mjs && astro build', { stdio: 'inherit' })"
